claims.summary: One-sided density with the Fejer kernel, G(tau) = -int_0^inf h(x) e^{i(x-L) tau} dx, h(x) = x e^{-delta x} P(x - L): int Re G(tau) e^{-i(x-L) tau} d tau = -pi (h(x) + conj h(2L - x)); and if the heights lie in an interval of length c delta and Re G <= S = eps M/delta^2 on the line, then |P(x - L)| <= M (e^{delta x}/(delta x)) ((2/pi)(c eps + 4 sqrt(eps)) + 4 b e^{-b}) for 0 < x <= L.
claims.assessment: Working proof: Fourier inversion for G and its conjugate, the integral of Re G from the value at x = L, and the decay of G away from the heights. The square root comes from the tail 2M/rho and halves the exponent in the theorem that uses it.
claims.rationale: Turns a one-sided bound for the off-line part of the density into a bound for the profile of the cluster's exponential sum.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

claims.summary: For P(y) = sum m_j e^{-i y gamma_j} with m_j > 0, M = sum m_j, heights in an interval of length c delta, b = delta L > 1 and 1/b < beta < 1: if log((1 - 1/b)/(1 - beta)) + (1 - beta)/(1 - 1/b) - 1 > pi c, then some x in [1/delta, beta L] has |P(x - L)| > M e^{-beta b} e^{delta x}/(delta x).
claims.assessment: Working proof: the sum is bounded by M in a half-plane and at least M e^{-v c delta} on the imaginary axis; the harmonic majorant of its logarithm, by the mean value inequality for subharmonic functions and Fatou's lemma, as v tends to 0.
claims.rationale: A lower bound for a sum of exponentials with positive coefficients on an interval away from the origin, free of the number of terms and of their gaps.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

notes.mathematical_status: Complete proof in the entry; the majorant inequality holds in 27 numerical cases, with equality where expected.
notes.significance: Context for the route: a standard argument (Jensen's inequality in a half-plane) applied to these sums. No novelty search beyond the registry.

claims.summary: One-sided density with the Fejer kernel, off-line pairs at one distance delta with heights in an interval of length c delta, c <= 1, b = delta L > 1, 1/b < beta < 1 with log((1 - 1/b)/(1 - beta)) + (1 - beta)/(1 - 1/b) - 1 > pi c: sup Re G >= (pi^2/100)(e^{-beta b} - 4 b e^{-b})_+^2 M/delta^2, so some tau has D_off <= -(2M/(L delta^2))((pi^2/100) e^b (e^{-beta b} - 4 b e^{-b})_+^2 - 3); no dependence on the number of pairs, their gaps or their multiplicities.
claims.assessment: Working proof from the two lemmas. The exponent lost is 2 beta, below 1 only for c < (ln 2 - 1/2)/pi = 0.0615 in the limit of large b; for wider windows the bound gives no negativity, and the hidden binomial family has c about 1.
claims.rationale: In the model every cluster confined to a window of height below 0.0615 delta shows in the one-sided density at a bounded multiple of a single pair's length, whatever its size.
claims.next_action: Extend to windows of height delta by removing the square root in the first lemma.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.
